visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair pulled back, wearing a black leather jacket and black pants, stands in front of a Costco warehouse entrance. She gestures enthusiastically with her arms while a large black wheeled bag stands next to her. The sky is blue with light clouds. (2) A series of close-up shots show various food items: a carton of eggs with a chicken illustration, many cartons of eggs on refrigerator shelves, a bag of mixed lettuce, a hand pouring creamy dressing onto greens, a plastic tub of tomatoes, and sliced tomatoes being added to a salad bowl. (3) The woman holds a large white bottle of soy milk in front of an open refrigerator; she pours the thick liquid into a clear glass. (4) Close-up of pork slices being flipped in a black frying pan with metal tongs; steam rises. (5) A bag of Kirkland Signature frozen shrimp is shown, followed by a shot of cooked shrimp on a plate with scrambled eggs. (6) The woman eats a piece of roasted seaweed and then a cube of cooked egg white snack in her kitchen. (7) Shot of a supermarket checkout area with empty cardboard boxes stacked below. (8) The woman stands outside showing off a large black 'HULKEN' bag. She demonstrates its size, the wheels on the bottom, the zipper top, and how it can be folded flat. (9) She pulls the bag along a concrete path and packs groceries from a shopping cart into it. (10) Finally, she sits on a concrete ledge next to the bag, smiling and gesturing towards it as a recommendation.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with black hair in a bun, wearing a cropped black leather jacket over a black top and wide-leg black trousers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between the exterior of a Costco warehouse with its iconic signage, an indoor kitchen with a modern refrigerator and stovetop, and an outdoor urban sidewalk area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, energetic female voice opens with a high-pitched greeting, asking 'What do people losing weight buy at Costco?'. A bright, acoustic pop BGM with a steady kick drum and strummed guitar starts immediately. (2) The voice rapidly lists food items—'Eggs... lettuce... salad dressing... large tomatoes...'—maintaining a high speech rate and cheerful tone. Faint sizzling sounds are audible briefly when meat is mentioned. (3) Transitioning to a new topic, the voice becomes more excited as she introduces the 'HULKEN' bag, noting how it replaces cardboard boxes. A short 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. (4) The speaker details product features like '30kg capacity' and 'silent wheels,' her voice staying clear and projected over the continuous BGM. Faint mechanical clicks and the sound of a zipper sliding can be heard in the background. (5) The video ends with a strong vocal recommendation and a summary of how easy shopping has become, with the BGM fading out just after the final sentence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide dietary recommendations for Costco shoppers focused on weight loss, while simultaneously promoting a specific high-capacity shopping bag (HULKEN) as a convenient tool for grocery trips.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a dedicated segment demonstrating the brand name, features, and benefits of the HULKEN bag.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines health-conscious lifestyle content with a product advertisement, using fast-paced editing and bright visuals to maintain high viewer engagement.
